description_en: Calls the CopyNetworkAclEntries operation to copy network ACL rules
description_zh: 调用CopyNetworkAclEntries接口复制网络ACL规则
kebab_example: aliyun vpc copy-network-acl-entries --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-acl-id nacl-a2do9e413e0spxxxxxxxx --source-network-acl-id nacl-ghuo9ehg3e0spxxxxxxxx --client-token 123 --dry-run false --region cn-hangzhou
name: CopyNetworkAclEntries

parameters.help_en: The region where the network ACL resides. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 网络ACL所在的地域。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network ACL
parameters.name: network_acl_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source network ACL from which rules are copied
parameters.name: source_network_acl_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
